title: Sweet Potato Quiche
subtitle: with a buttery shortcrust and thyme
description: A quiche with a buttery shortcrust base, roasted sweet potato slices and a creamy cheese custard, finished with fresh thyme.

steps.text: Make the pastry: in a mixer with a paddle attachment, combine the flour, cold butter and salt to form crumbs. Add the egg yolks and mix just until large clumps form. If the dough does not come together, add very cold water.
Roll the dough out between two sheets of baking paper to a round about 0.5 cm thick. Press it into the base of the tin, straighten the sides and prick the base with a fork. Freeze for 1 hour.
Meanwhile make the filling: bake the sweet potatoes until soft, 30-40 minutes, then cool, peel and slice.
Whisk the cream, eggs, flour, salt and black pepper in a bowl until smooth. Add the cheeses and mix well.

Blind bake the pastry: place baking paper over the dough and weigh it down with dried beans or pulses. Bake for 15 minutes, until the pastry is cooked but still pale. Carefully remove the paper and beans.

Arrange the sweet potato slices in the tart shell and pour the cheese mixture over. Sprinkle with a little thyme and return to the oven for about 30 minutes, or until the edges of the pastry and the top are baked.
